title: CoTerms Public Pilot R0
purpose: A small public-safe glossary that explains recurring CoCivium terms without publishing the full private or historical CoLex estate.

release_scope.projection_rule: plain meaning + anti-meaning + status + related terms

status_legend.MATURE_INTERNAL_USE: Widely recurring in project practice; still not made canon merely by this publication.
status_legend.WORKING_CANDIDATE: Useful and active, but meaning may change materially.
status_legend.WORKING_NAME_CANDIDATE: Naming/branding candidate specifically expected to evolve.
status_legend.PUBLIC_EXPLAINER_CANDIDATE: This rendering is selected for a bounded public glossary; the underlying semantic object may have richer internal forms.

terms.meaning: A developing civic, social, and knowledge software environment for humans and AI systems to coordinate through explicit relationships, inspectable evidence, consent, and portable trust.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a government, political party, religion, claim of AI sentience, or proof that every described capability is already deployed.

terms.meaning: The wider relational workspace and architecture that connects CoCivium projects, artifacts, terms, modules, receipts, histories, and coordination surfaces.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a claim to contain all knowledge, all data, one universal truth, or one monolithic authority.

terms.meaning: A named semantic handle whose meaning, context, relationships, provenance, and version can be tracked explicitly.
terms.anti_meaning: A CoTerm is not automatically canonical, permanent, universally agreed, or context-free.

terms.meaning: The evolving collection of CoTerms together with their meanings, relationships, alternatives, disagreements, versions, and provenance.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a frozen dictionary and not proof that every historic term should be publicly served.

terms.meaning: An evolving lexicon or registry for CoTerms, meanings, relationships, anti-meanings, versions, and schema bindings.
terms.anti_meaning: Not necessarily the sole authority for meaning, and a rendering of CoLex is not itself canon.

terms.meaning: A meaning record that can carry context, time, scope, source, alternatives, and changes instead of pretending a word has one timeless definition.
terms.anti_meaning: Not an assertion that meaning is arbitrary or that contradictions should be erased.

terms.meaning: An explicit typed relationship between things, such as depends-on, derived-from, conflicts-with, supersedes, receives, or projects-to.
terms.anti_meaning: A relation does not imply causation, authority, equivalence, or currentness unless its type and evidence say so.

terms.meaning: The internal durable workbench and custody layer for artifacts, receipts, schemas, advisory work, and append-only project evidence.
terms.anti_meaning: Not the public website and not proof that every file present there is accepted, current, or canonical.

terms.meaning: The stewardship and continuity layer for provenance, receipt indexes, durable handoffs, planning roots, and long-lived project memory.
terms.anti_meaning: Not an infallible memory oracle and not a substitute for exact evidence or currentness checks.

terms.meaning: A machine-readable evidence object that records what exact action or transition was observed, what it affected, and what remains unproven.
terms.anti_meaning: A receipt does not by itself prove acceptance, authority, integration, canon, runtime activation, or public release.

terms.meaning: A strong externalization state: an object is appropriately externalized, discoverable, relationally linked, and reusable through its intended surface.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a synonym for local existence, upload, delivery, canon, runtime activation, or public publication.

terms.meaning: A public-safe externalization path or state in which material has crossed explicit privacy, provenance, claim, and release boundaries into a public surface.
terms.anti_meaning: Not every CoEx is public, and a public-safe candidate is not published until the release edge actually occurs.

terms.meaning: A reserved proof term for a demonstrated CoAll mutation with identity, provenance, authority chain, and appropriate merge or readback evidence.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a progress animation, status message, heartbeat, optimistic summary, or claim that work merely exists.

terms.meaning: A compact statement of the best currently supported state at the present observation boundary.
terms.anti_meaning: Not timeless truth, newest-wins, or a guarantee that every other observer has the same state.

terms.meaning: An explicit account of holds, unknowns, contradictions, boundaries, and important nonclaims around the current state.
terms.anti_meaning: Not necessarily failure; uncertainty and held effects can be the correct state.

terms.meaning: A lightweight visible snapshot or signal that useful activity or progress has occurred at an observation boundary.
terms.anti_meaning: Not proof of mutation, acceptance, authority, or completion.

history.summary: Earlier public wording treated CoPulse specifically as a snapshot of system state at a wave; preserved as source-time evidence rather than overwritten.

terms.meaning: A recurring liveness or progress signal intended to make long-running work visibly recoverable and less dependent on human prompting.
terms.anti_meaning: Not proof that the signaled work is correct, current, accepted, or authorized.

terms.meaning: An observer-first product quality in which system state, progress, recovery, and meaningful next actions are visibly understandable rather than hidden behind opaque automation.
terms.anti_meaning: Visual activity alone does not prove operational truth, successful execution, or acceptance.

terms.meaning: A relational treatment of time that keeps source-time, observation-time, currentness, prediction, supersession, and parallel temporal branches distinct when needed.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a claim that there is one universal current file, one latest-wins timeline, or that predictions are facts.

terms.meaning: One bounded action with a clear purpose, effect envelope, and proof or completion condition.
terms.anti_meaning: Not blanket authorization for adjacent actions or an excuse to expand scope silently.

terms.meaning: A policy-controlled connection that moves information or work between tools, devices, people, AI systems, or custody surfaces while preserving relevant destination, consent, provenance, and delivery state.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a user-facing catalog of transport internals, not automatic permission, and not proof that delivery became pickup, acceptance, or integration.

terms.meaning: A shared durable coordination path through which systems can publish needs, offers, receipts, conflicts, pickup evidence, and return signals without making a person relay them manually.
terms.anti_meaning: Not hidden inter-chat telepathy, not automatic acceptance, and not authority inherited from message delivery.

terms.meaning: The work-orchestration layer for compiling, deduplicating, routing, scheduling, backpressuring, and fanning-in many bounded work items.
terms.anti_meaning: A queue entry is not execution, and parallel research does not imply parallel authority expansion.

terms.meaning: A reconciliation role or process for plural, conflicting, or differently timed evidence so that disagreement can be preserved and resolved without silent newest-wins behavior.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a rule that all branches must collapse into one view, and not automatic authority to select a winner.

terms.meaning: The public memory, beacon, and dissemination layer for material that has been deliberately prepared for public discovery, reuse, critique, and provenance-aware history.
terms.anti_meaning: Not a dump of private custody, raw sessions, internal receipts, or every preserved artifact.

terms.meaning: The boundary and translation layer that separates internal and external surfaces, including redaction, public/private routing, APIs, authentication, safety, and trust metadata.
terms.anti_meaning: Translation does not create authority, erase provenance, or make private material public by default.

terms.meaning: A structured identity handle that can carry scope, provenance, qualifiers, permissions, relationships, and context for a person, agent, service, or other participant.
terms.anti_meaning: Not automatic proof of a real-world identity, trustworthiness, personhood, or authority.

terms.meaning: A modular capability or experience that can be composed into a larger CoCivium environment while retaining explicit inputs, outputs, dependencies, boundaries, and provenance.
terms.anti_meaning: A named module is not automatically implemented, enabled, safe for every context, or authoritative.

terms.meaning: A working internal semantic umbrella for the shared relational civic and social environment in CoCivium.
terms.anti_meaning: Not yet a fixed public brand or claim that the shared environment is one homogeneous community.

terms.meaning: A leading working public-facing name for a lively shared place for news, research, communities, humour, challenges, civic participation, and human-plus-AI interaction.
terms.anti_meaning: Not merely a social-media feed, not a governing authority, and not yet canonized branding.

terms.meaning: A compact working shorthand and possible app mark for the public CoAgora+ experience.
terms.anti_meaning: Not the full semantic substrate, not a finalized trademark claim, and not proof of a released application.

license_note: Repository-level license and any future documentation-specific reuse license must be interpreted separately; this glossary does not silently rewrite licensing policy.
correction_policy: Future releases may correct, supersede, dispute, deprecate, or archive individual meanings while preserving prior public history.

public_ux_rule.headline: Complexity behind; consequence in front.
public_ux_rule.normal_user: Show intent, destination/consequence, privacy/consent/cost/public exposure when material, and result state.
public_ux_rule.power_user: Allow expansion into route, provenance, pickup, and receipt evidence.
public_ux_rule.operator: Expose bridge selection, capabilities, retries, leases, failover, diagnostics, and policy details.
public_ux_rule.bridge_rule: Long bridge use-case and transport matrices are not primary user-facing content.
